pages.name: Two Knights: Morphy, Main Line 9.Nf3 e4
pages.notes: Plan 2 challenged the e4-pawn with Ne1-d3, ignoring that the f3-knight is attacked; rewritten around 10.Ne5. Overview notes 9...e4 hits f3. British spelling.

pages.name: Two Knights: Morphy, Steiner Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 used a ...d4 break with no black d-pawn; rewritten. The first plan 2 rewrite (d4 gaining time on the bishop) was rejected because ...exd3 e.p. answers it; reworded and accepted. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Alapin Defense
pages.notes: Plans 2 and 3 played ...Bxc3 and bxc3 with no knight on c3; plan 4 castled with the g8-knight at home. Rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Bulgarian Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 wrote Bxc6 bxc6 as one side's moves; plan 4 rerouted the f3-knight via d2 with the d-pawn there. Rewritten as the Nb1-d2-f1-g3 manoeuvre. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Cozio Defense, Tartakower Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 2 named O-O-O inside Black's plan, so it read as Black castling queenside; reworded. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Nürnberg Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3 claimed f5 and h5 as weak squares to occupy, with no piece able to reach them; rewritten around the a2-g8 diagonal. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Pollock Defense
pages.notes: Overview said 3...Na5 challenges the b5-bishop and missed that it drops the e5-pawn to Nxe5; plan 1 wrote ...b5 onto the bishop. Rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Rotary-Albany Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 3 targeted an "a6-b6 pawn structure" that does not exist; rewritten around the c6-knight defending e5. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Vinogradov Variation
pages.notes: Overview said 3...Qe7 breaks a pin (there is none) and avoids doubled pawns (Bxc6 dxc6 still doubles them); plan 2 called the fianchetto a fix for the light-squared bishop. Rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Alapin, 4.c3
pages.notes: Plan 2 had Black exchange the bishop for the c3-pawn; plan 3 questioned a bishop c3 already attacks. Rewritten (reviewer rejected d4 always gaining time, true only after ...Bc5; fixed and accepted). British spelling.
